links.outcome: Whether autonomous modeling agents select prediction-time leaking features that inflate validation performance
links.effect: DeepSeek Flash and GPT-6-astra each leak in 10/10 unconstrained runs and 0/10 runs with an explicit admission-time constraint; Claude/Fable-5.1 chat run did not leak in either condition.
links.quote: A deterministic optimizer and every evaluated unconstrained local-model configuration select a fatal leaking feature.

unlisted_practices: Deterministic provenance-based verifier-in-loop to block prediction-time-invalid features in agent modeling
Explicit admission-time constraint in agent prompts to prevent leakage
Specific verifier feedback in LLM repair loop for clearing leakage

screen.practice: provenance verifier-in-loop and explicit admission-time constraints
screen.reason: Evaluates audit/guardrail mechanisms (such as admission-time constraints, verifier-in-loop, and verifier feedback) to prevent reward hacking and data leakage by autonomous clinical modeling agents on clinical datasets.
